div.span: Rules in order: busy or loading models are never released; pressure releases least recently used first; then idle time; then deep idle; yield shortens idle times while a full-screen app runs. Half way to idle the context is cleared and the weights stay.

text.tspan: Rules in order: busy or loading models are never released; pressure
releases least recently used first; then idle time; then deep idle; yield
shortens idle times while a full-screen app runs. Half way to idle the
context is cleared and the weights stay.
